description: Kinde org-wide Renovate preset: auto-merge stable non-major npm/pnpm and GitHub Actions updates once CI and the AI dependency-risk check pass; other managers and majors need a human.

packageRules.description: Group stable non-major npm/pnpm and GitHub Actions updates into one weekly PR and auto-merge it once all required checks pass
Auto-merge lockfile maintenance only for pnpm-lock.yaml, the only lockfile the dependency-risk check can review (the npm manager also covers package-lock.json and yarn.lock)
0.x packages can break on a minor bump: separate PRs, a human merges them
Major updates wait for a tick in the Dependency Dashboard and are never auto-merged
